title: Air Leak Detection and Treatment
official: Defining Novel Strategies for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Intraoperative Air Leaks: An Ex-Vivo Human Lung Model Study
summary: Developing a methodology to detect, quantify and treat air leaks intraoperatively using a bio-adhesive, to thereby reduce postoperative surgical complications, morbidity, and length of stay for patients undergoing pulmonary resection.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing lung transplant surgery
* Organ donor ineligible to donate lungs

Exclusion Criteria:

* Healthy individuals
sponsor: Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM)
